camel_example: aliyun dataworks-public CreateCrawler --region cn-hangzhou --Type starrocks --DataSourceId 12345 --Name example_crawler
description_en: Creates a metadata crawler and configures the data source, collection scope, resource group, and scheduling method
description_zh: 创建一个元数据采集器，并配置数据源、采集范围、资源组和调度方式
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-crawler --name example_crawler --data-source-id 12345 --type starrocks --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCrawler

parameters.help_en: The name of the metadata crawler. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 元数据采集器名称，长度不超过 128 个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data source associated with the crawler. The data source must be bound to a DataWorks workspace, and the data source type must match the Type value
parameters.help_zh: 采集器关联的数据源 ID。数据源需要已绑定 DataWorks 工作空间，且数据源类型与 Type 匹配
parameters.name: data_source_id

parameters.help_en: The crawler type. Call GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities to query the valid values supported in the current region
parameters.help_zh: 采集器类型。可调用 GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities 查询当前地域支持的取值
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Serverless 2.0 resource group used to run the collection task. Whether this parameter is required depends on the RequireResourceGroup value returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities
parameters.help_zh: 运行采集任务使用的 Serverless 2.0 资源组 ID。是否需要填写以 GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities 返回的 RequireResourceGroup 为准
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The regular expression used to exclude objects from the collection scope. This parameter is supported only when the SupportExcludeRegex value returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities is true
fields.help_zh: 采集范围排除正则表达式。仅当 GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities 返回的 SupportExcludeRegex 为 true 时支持
fields.name: exclude_regex

fields.help_en: The list of database names. This parameter is supported only when Unit is set to DATABASE. A maximum of 1000 entries are allowed. Names cannot be empty or duplicated
fields.help_zh: 数据库名称列表。仅当 Unit 为 DATABASE 时支持填写，最多 1000 个，名称不能为空或重复
fields.name: items

fields.help_en: The collection scope granularity. Valid values are determined by the SupportedScopeUnits value returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities
fields.help_zh: 采集范围粒度。可选值以 GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities 返回的 SupportedScopeUnits 为准
fields.name: unit

parameters.help_en: The collection scope configuration. If this parameter is not specified, the DefaultScopeUnit value returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities is used
parameters.help_zh: 采集范围配置。未传入时，使用 GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities 返回的 DefaultScopeUnit
parameters.name: scope

fields.help_en: The six-field cron expression for periodic scheduling. This parameter is required when Type is set to NORMAL. The seconds field must be 0, and the scheduling frequency cannot exceed once per hour
fields.help_zh: 周期调度的六段式 Cron 表达式。Type 为 NORMAL 时必填；秒位必须为 0，调度频率不得高于每小时一次
fields.name: cron_express

fields.help_en: The scheduling type. MANUAL indicates manual execution, and NORMAL indicates periodic scheduling. Data sources in the development environment support only MANUAL. Whether NORMAL is available depends on the SupportSchedule value returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities
fields.help_zh: 调度类型。MANUAL 表示手动运行，NORMAL 表示周期调度。开发环境数据源仅支持 MANUAL；NORMAL 是否可用以 GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities 返回的 SupportSchedule 为准
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The scheduling configuration. If this parameter is not specified, manual scheduling is used
parameters.help_zh: 调度配置。未传入时使用手动调度
parameters.name: schedule_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable AI metadata descriptions. This parameter is supported only when the SupportAiComment value returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities is true
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用 AI 元数据描述。仅当 GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities 返回的 SupportAiComment 为 true 时支持
parameters.name: enable_ai_comment

parameters.help_en: The extended configuration for the crawler type. The key names, value types, required fields, default values, and valid values are determined by the SupportedOptionKeys value returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities
parameters.help_zh: 采集器类型的扩展配置。键名、值类型、必填性、默认值和可选值以 GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities 返回的 SupportedOptionKeys 为准
parameters.name: options

Id.description_en: The ID of the newly created metadata crawler
Id.description_zh: 新创建的元数据采集器 ID

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
